title: CORE Agent Task v1
description: Schema for a domain-neutral agent task describing what an agent intends to do. CORE validates structure; downstream forks interpret intent and slots.

intent.description: Natural-language description of the task intent.

slots.description: Key-value pairs for structured task parameters.

vocabulary_id.description: Optional vocabulary domain identifier for domain-specific interpretation.

classification_candidate_ref.description: Optional reference to a classification_candidate that produced this task.

requires_command_validation.description: Whether command validation is required. Must be true.

forbidden_patterns.description: Patterns that must not appear in task execution.

trigger_fingerprint.description: Optional SHA-256 fingerprint of the triggering event.
